Use with caution / monitor (Dose limit applies)

Co-administration of clarithromycin with atorvastatin increases atorvastatin plasma concentrations due to the inhibition of CYP3A4 and/or transporters [clarithromycin:warnings_and_cautions:8, atorvastatin:drug_interactions:6]. This elevated exposure significantly increases the risk of adverse muscle events, including myopathy and rhabdomyolysis [clarithromycin:warnings_and_cautions:8, atorvastatin:drug_interactions:6]. Consequently, if concomitant use cannot be avoided, the daily dose of atorvastatin must not exceed 20 mg [clarithromycin:warnings_and_cautions:8, atorvastatin:drug_interactions:6].
